name: fix-sphere-intersect-sphere
title: Fix sphere_intersect_sphere - correct intersection metric
description: Fix sphere-sphere intersection metric: current formula sum_r_sq - dist_sq + diff_r_sq is wrong for tangent equal spheres (returns 1 instead of 0)
creator: denkijin
notes: Implemented correct branchless product-form metric in sphere_intersect_sphere() (src/lib.rs:171-183): ((r1+r2)² - d²) * (d² - (r1-r2)²). Gives 0 at tangency, >0 when intersecting, <0 when separated or one fully inside. Library compiles. Emission updates require parser signature changes (out of scope).
